root_cause.text: The nx842 crypto context code in drivers/crypto/nx/nx-842.c mismatched page-allocation and page-freeing APIs by allocating multi-page bounce buffers with __get_free_pages(..., BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER) but freeing them as single pages with free_page(), causing leaked pages.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes both the alloc error path and nx842_crypto_free_ctx() from free_page((unsigned long)ctx->sbounce/dbounce) to free_pages((unsigned long)ctx->sbounce/dbounce, BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER), and the CVE/commit explicitly states the buffers were allocated with order-2 __get_free_pages() but released with free_page().

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix nx842 context allocation cleanup to free multi-page bounce buffers with free_pages using the correct allocation order.
intent_record.what: In the allocation failure path of nx842_crypto_alloc_ctx(), the cleanup code was changed to replace free_page((unsigned long)ctx->sbounce) and free_page((unsigned long)ctx->dbounce) with free_pages((unsigned long)ctx->sbounce, BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER) and free_pages((unsigned long)ctx->dbounce, BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER).
intent_record.how: This makes the deallocation match the earlier __get_free_pages(..., BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER) allocations for the bounce buffers, correctly freeing the full multi-page allocations instead of attempting to free them as single pages, which prevents memory leaks or allocator misuse on error cleanup.

intent_record.intent_summary: Fix nx842 context cleanup to free bounce buffers with free_pages() using the correct allocation order.
intent_record.what: The function nx842_crypto_free_ctx() was changed to replace two calls to free_page() for ctx->sbounce and ctx->dbounce with free_pages(..., BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER), passing the allocation order when freeing both bounce buffers.
intent_record.how: At runtime, the bounce buffers are now freed using the correct multi-page deallocation API and order instead of being treated as single pages, which prevents incorrect memory freeing and potential leaks or allocator corruption when the buffers span more than one page.

relevance_review.reason: The changes directly fix the root cause by replacing single-page free_page() cleanup with free_pages() using the same multi-page allocation order as __get_free_pages(..., BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER), addressing the page leak in nx842 context cleanup.

candidates.rationale: ctx->sbounce was allocated with __get_free_pages(..., BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER), so freeing it with free_page() releases only a single page instead of the full multi-page allocation, causing leaked pages.
ctx->dbounce was allocated with __get_free_pages(..., BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER), so using free_page() mismatches the allocation API and frees only one page from a multi-page buffer.
The normal context cleanup path also frees the multi-page sbounce buffer with free_page(), directly embodying the allocation/free mismatch that leaks pages.
The normal context cleanup path frees dbounce with free_page() despite it being allocated as a multi-page region, causing incomplete freeing and page leaks.

vuln_statements.explanation: ctx->sbounce was allocated as a multi-page buffer with __get_free_pages(..., BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER), but this statement frees it with free_page(), releasing only a single page and causing leaked pages.

ctx->dbounce was allocated as a multi-page buffer with __get_free_pages(..., BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER), but this statement uses free_page() instead of free_pages(..., BOUNCE_BUFFER_ORDER), creating the allocation/free mismatch and leaking the remaining pages.
